WITH lab_patient AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    CASE WHEN l.WBC IS NOT NULL AND l.PLT IS NOT NULL THEN l.WBC / l.PLT ELSE NULL END AS wbc_plt_ratio,
    CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL THEN l.HGB / l.HCT ELSE NULL END AS hgb_hct_ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
sex_group_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(wbc_plt_ratio) AS avg_wbc_plt,
    AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) AS avg_hgb_hct
  FROM lab_patient
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wbc_plt) AS overall_avg_wbc_plt
  FROM sex_group_avg
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.avg_wbc_plt,
  s.avg_hgb_hct,
  s.avg_wbc_plt - o.overall_avg_wbc_plt AS difference
FROM sex_group_avg s
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wbc_plt IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.SEX
